rule: In standardized source-trained branch latent coordinates, compute each source row nearest squared distance to a different source cell. Scale is median of per-cell medians, floored1e-8. At inference gate=1/(1+nearest_source_distance_squared/(scale*multiplier)). Multiply selected branch gain by gate, shared across all8parents.
selection: Reuse all4 trainedGPs and8validation branches; evaluate3multipliers*5gains for each branch. Original B123 domain-equal validation MAE selects shared choice. All21choices frozen before outer score. Ties smaller gain then key then multiplier.
acceptance: Original all3dataset all3metric independent,incremental,16group complementarity,paired uncertainty andrisk stability requirements unchanged
controls: Same branch/key/gain with gate removed,plus original independently selected ungated screen
limits: No gate fitting labels or target-query statistics; fixed source-neighborhood scale
